info.description: API Gateway for Pinz mobile client
info.title: Pinz API Gateway

post.description: For development use only. Returns access and refresh tokens for any existing user without passkey verification.
post.summary: Dev login — bypass passkey, get tokens by email only

post.description: User sends email. Response indicates if user is registered (next step: passkey login) or not (next step: email verification). registration_id is set only when is_registered is false.
Returns PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions (options_json) to pass to navigator.credentials.get(). Call after /auth/email confirms is_registered=true.
Verifies the assertion from the authenticator. Returns access and refresh tokens.

parameters.description: User email and assertion credential JSON
parameters.name: body

post.description: Returns PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions (options_json) to pass to navigator.credentials.create(). Call after email verification.
Verifies the attestation from the authenticator and creates the user account. Returns access and refresh tokens.

parameters.description: Registration ID and attestation credential JSON
parameters.name: body

get.description: Text search over pin name, description and tags within trips where the user participates. Requires JWT.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the user account. Pins and media in trips are preserved.
Removes the user's avatar. Deletes the file from S3 and clears avatar_url.

post.summary: Confirm avatar upload after uploading to S3
Request presigned URL for avatar upload
Initiate email change (sends verification code to new email)
Confirm email change with verification code

post.description: Registers an APNS device token for the authenticated user. Idempotent: повторная регистрация того же токена допустима (обновится owner).

delete.description: Removes an APNS device token for the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns counters (trips, pins, media, likes, dislikes, battles) for authenticated user.
Returns countries/cities where the user had trips. Optional ?type=Country|City.
Returns list of trips for the authenticated user. Requires JWT.

post.description: Creates a new trip (creation flow stage 1: init + S3 upload URLs). Requires JWT. user_id is taken from JWT.

parameters.description: Pin updates and media to delete
parameters.name: body

get.description: Returns trips the user has added to favourites. Supports limit and offset query params.

post.description: Joins the current user to a trip using an invite token. Requires JWT.

get.description: Returns a single trip by ID with pins and media in each pin. Requires JWT. User must be a participant.

delete.description: Deletes a trip. Requires JWT. Only owner can delete.

patch.description: Updates trip metadata (name, description, category, season, dates). Requires JWT. Any trip participant can update (ТЗ 3.2). Обложка — через /cover/upload + /cover/confirm. Приватность — через PUT /trips/{id}/privacy (per-user, ТЗ 6.4-6.7).

post.description: Picks 8 random media from the trip and starts a battle session. Returns 412 if the trip has fewer than 8 available media (ТЗ 8.1.9).
Records the final winner of a photo battle; increments media battle_rating by 1. Can be called once per battle.

get.description: Returns media of the trip with battle_rating > 0, sorted by rating DESC. Empty array when the trip has no winners yet (ТЗ 8.2.3).

delete.description: Removes the trip cover: deletes the file from S3 and clears cover_url. Requires JWT. Any trip participant can perform this action.

post.description: Step 2 of the cover upload flow. Requires JWT. Any trip participant can perform this action.
post.summary: Confirm trip cover upload after uploading to S3

post.description: Step 1 of the cover upload flow (mirrors user avatar). Requires JWT. Any trip participant can perform this action.
post.summary: Request presigned URL for trip cover upload

post.description: Creates an invite link for the trip. Only participants can generate. Requires JWT.
Current user leaves the trip. If sole admin, trip may be deleted or new admin assigned. Requires JWT.

parameters.description: Draft pins, deleted media, session id
parameters.name: body

post.summary: Commit uploaded file to add-media session
Request upload URLs for active add-media session

parameters.description: Session id and files to upload
parameters.name: body

post.description: Идемпотентен: если caller уже ведущий, вернёт 200 без изменений. Если час не прошёл — 403 NOT_INITIATOR.

put.description: Текущий пользователь выставляет свой уровень приватности на медиа (ТЗ 6.4.3 / 5.2). Эффективный privacy_level пересчитывается по AggregatePrivacyLevel (ТЗ 6.6/6.7) и возвращается в ответе. Только участник трипа.

delete.description: Removes a participant from the trip. Only admin can remove. Requires JWT.

put.description: Текущий пользователь выставляет свой уровень приватности на пине (ТЗ 6.4.2 / 4.2.10). Эффективный privacy_level пересчитывается по AggregatePrivacyLevel (ТЗ 6.6/6.7) и возвращается в ответе. Только участник трипа.

Текущий пользователь выставляет свой уровень приватности на путешествии (ТЗ 6.4.1). Эффективный privacy_level пересчитывается по AggregatePrivacyLevel (ТЗ 6.6/6.7) и возвращается в ответе. Только участник трипа.

credential_json.description: CredentialJSON is the PublicKeyCredential (assertion) object serialised to JSON by the client.
CredentialJSON is the PublicKeyCredential (attestation) object serialised to JSON by the client.

details.description:
Details — дополнительные structured-поля для конкретного reason. Пример:
{"remaining_slots": 2, "limit": 500, "kind": "media"} для LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

reason.description:
Reason — машинный код ошибки (например, "SESSION_STALE", "NOT_INITIATOR",
"WRONG_STATUS", "LIMIT_EXCEEDED"). Клиент может различать сценарии и
реагировать по-разному, не парся текст Error.

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and the JWT access token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
